Abdul El-Sayed's Past Videos Criticizing July 4th and 2nd Amendment Surface

Former Michigan gubernatorial candidate Abdul El-Sayed has made approximately 100 of his YouTube videos private. The move follows the resurfacing of past videos where El-Sayed criticized the Fourth of July tradition, calling fireworks "suck," and suggested replacing the Second Amendment. El-Sayed's campaign stated these posts are old and do not reflect his current views.
